topic: uniform trust code applicability
rule_statement: New Jersey's Uniform Trust Code applies to express trusts, charitable or noncharitable, and statutory, judgment, or decree trusts administered as express trusts.

exceptions.rule: Specific statutes, judgments, decrees, and mandatory UTC rules may control.

topic: trust creation requirements settlor capacity purpose definite beneficiaries charitable oral trusts
rule_statement: Trust creation in New Jersey requires statutory creation method and creation requirements, including capacity, intent, duties, property, valid purpose, and beneficiary rules; charitable and limited noncharitable trusts have separate rules.

exceptions.rule: Evidence and statute-of-frauds issues require professional review.

topic: governing law principal place of administration trust registration
rule_statement: New Jersey trust governing law and principal place of administration analysis begins with N.J.S.A. 3B:31-7 and 3B:31-8; registration issues require separate court and local practice review.

exceptions.rule: No production registration rule is encoded in Phase 1.

topic: trustee acceptance resignation removal successor trustees co-trustees compensation
rule_statement: Trustee acceptance, resignation, removal, co-trustee conduct, vacancies, successor appointment, and reimbursement are governed by New Jersey UTC trustee provisions; compensation must be reviewed under trust terms and applicable fiduciary law.

topic: trustee powers duties loyalty prudence impartiality recordkeeping reporting beneficiary information rights
rule_statement: New Jersey trustee duties include administration, loyalty, impartiality, prudence, special skills, delegation, control and protection, recordkeeping, reporting/disclosure, discretionary powers, and general statutory powers.

exceptions.rule: Mandatory and default-rule split must be checked before applying trust terms.

topic: certification of trust
rule_statement: New Jersey recognizes certification of trust under N.J.S.A. 3B:31-81; users should provide issue-spotting output only until the certificate content and transaction context are professionally reviewed.

topic: modification reformation termination nonjudicial settlement agreements uneconomic trust termination decanting
rule_statement: New Jersey UTC provides multiple modification, reformation, termination, nonjudicial settlement, uneconomic trust, tax objective, combination, and division pathways; Phase 1 does not encode a completed New Jersey decanting conclusion.

exceptions.rule: Open question in Phase 1; do not produce final decanting instruction.

topic: revocable trust exposure settlor creditor rules
rule_statement: During revocability, New Jersey UTC settlor-creditor and settlor-power provisions require treating revocable trust exposure as an issue requiring creditor review rather than asset-protection certainty.

exceptions.rule: Federal bankruptcy overlay is not marked complete.

topic: irrevocable trust settlor benefit self-settled trust limitations powers of withdrawal beneficiary serving as trustee
rule_statement: For irrevocable trusts involving settlor benefit, self-settled features, powers of withdrawal, or beneficiary-trustee control, New Jersey UTC creditor provisions require human review before any protection conclusion.

topic: spendthrift provisions discretionary trusts mandatory distributions overdue distributions creditor exceptions
rule_statement: New Jersey UTC has separate rules for spendthrift restrictions, discretionary trusts, mandatory distributions, overdue distributions, and creditor exceptions; the system may warn and cite but not approve creditor-protection outcomes.

topic: uniform voidable transactions act actual intent constructive fraud present future creditors limitations periods
rule_statement: New Jersey UVTA issues include actual-intent and constructive theories, present versus future creditors, limitations, remedies, burdens, and debtor-location governing law; no transfer should be encoded as protective without review.

exceptions.rule: Federal bankruptcy avoidance powers require federal review.

topic: exemptions wage garnishment bank account levy retirement life insurance annuity tenancy by the entirety homestead support government bankruptcy overlays
rule_statement: New Jersey exemption, wage garnishment, bank levy, retirement account, life insurance, annuity, tenancy by the entirety, homestead, support, government-claim, and bankruptcy overlay issues remain human-review gated in Phase 1.

exceptions.rule: No claim is encoded that a bank signature card defeats levy.

topic: filing office central local fixture filings transmitting utilities electronic filing filing fees
rule_statement: For New Jersey Article 9, central filing is generally with the state filing office except fixture, as-extracted, and timber-related local real-property filings; transmitting utilities and electronic filing require Article 9, DORES, and N.J.A.C. review.

exceptions.rule: Fixture filing may require local real property office.

topic: debtor naming organization names individual names trusts as debtors nonuniform New Jersey provisions current Article 9 amendments transition rules
rule_statement: New Jersey debtor-name rules include registered organizations, individuals, and trusts as debtors; trust collateral requires the statutory trust-name or settlor/testator naming path and separate indication that collateral is held in trust.

exceptions.rule: Individual debtor rule depends on current unexpired New Jersey driver's license status.

topic: historical trust debtor naming pre 2013
rule_statement: Historical pre-2013 New Jersey Article 9 debtor-name treatment remains available only for historical analysis and is superseded for current filings by the 2013 amendments.

topic: financing statements amendments assignments continuations terminations information statements continuation window lapse
rule_statement: New Jersey Article 9 financing statements, amendments, assignments, continuations, terminations, information statements, lapse, and continuation windows are governed by enacted Article 9 and official filing-office rules.

exceptions.rule: Continuation timing must be calculated from the actual lapse date.

topic: filing office rejection grounds search requests search logic
rule_statement: New Jersey UCC rejection and search logic must follow Article 9 and N.J.A.C. 17:33 filing-office procedures; ambiguous, unauthorized, false, fraudulent, or defective records may trigger refusal or removal review.

exceptions.rule: Current official N.J.A.C. text should be checked before final advice.

topic: unsupported private bank signature card levy claim
rule_statement: The unsupported claim that an ordinary bank signature card defeats levy is quarantined and cannot become an active jurisdiction rule.

topic: future rule selection fixture
rule_statement: Future fixture rule must not apply early.

topic: missing date fixture
rule_statement: Missing date fixture must require review.

topic: overlapping conflict fixture
rule_statement: Conflict fixture A.

topic: overlapping conflict fixture
rule_statement: Conflict fixture B.
